verdict.rationale: Versioning and rolling back automations is a fair question for an AI API platform that offers managed agents and background execution, so the axis applies. However, the pack has no evidence that Gemini versions, reviews, or rolls back a user's own automations or agents. The only versioning evidence covers pinnable model IDs and moving `-latest` aliases, which is model-release versioning rather than user automation history, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can version, review, and roll back my automations
